conditions.test_method: three-point bending test, span 25 mm, cross-speed 0.1 mm/min

evidence.quote: when C content increases to 1.14 at.%, the bending strength of the alloy reaches the highest point (1050 MPa)
the alloy with 1.14 at.% C possesses the highest compressive strength (2.22 GPa)

conditions.test_method: indentation fracture toughness, KC = 0.016 (E/H)^(1/2) P c^(-3/2)

evidence.quote: the alloy with 1.14 at.% C possesses the highest compressive strength (2.22 GPa) and fracture toughness (13.87 GPa)

conditions.test_method: MH-5 microhardness tester, load 1000 N, dwell 10 s

evidence.quote: that of the alloy with 10.35 at.% C possesses the highest value (9.8 GPa)

The alloys with 1.14% C possessed the highest bending strength, compressive strength and fracture toughness due to the effect of solution strengthening of C addition and the ﬁne and uniform microstructure.
The strengthen mechanism is mainly grain ﬁning and solid solution strengthening of C.
